scope: Personal pension Strategy 30/32 component ablation and independent QQQ/BIL sleeves
historical_exposure: These histories have already been examined in earlier research. This fixes the current experiment before running it; it does not establish an unseen test set.

independent_sleeves.SMA_SLEEVES: Each sleeve holds QQQ if close exceeds its trailing arithmetic moving average; otherwise BIL.
independent_sleeves.EXCESS_SLEEVES: Each sleeve holds QQQ if its horizon total return exceeds BIL's; otherwise BIL.

comparison_calendar: All candidates use the calendar available to the baseline on the same dataset.

historical_followup_screen.meaning: Passing is a historical follow-up candidate, not production approval. Actual Korean pension instruments and forward observations remain necessary.

stress_plan: Run cost 3x, one extra execution session, and KRW translation for BASE30 plus candidates clearing current CAGR/MDD screen. If none clears it, test the highest-CAGR ablation and highest-CAGR independent family as diagnostics without changing this screen.
